scope: Offline archival migration of 56 literature, 11 candidate-audit, 3 independent-search and 5 seed-verification quotations; no benchmark keys read.

past_missing_lineage.detail: All nine PDFs had layout and reading-order text extractions, and four also had compact whitespace-normalized text. These were deleted together with their PDFs; no hashes were recorded.

limitations: Verified means preserved-byte integrity, raw/text linkage and an exact located quotation; it does not certify scientific truth, novelty, or semantic entailment.
Extraction is an explicit provenance attestation, not a re-extraction test.
Original reviewer location labels are retained, not independently page-validated; character offsets are mechanically verified.
Normalized historical quotation searches retain both the original asserted quote and the exact source span; normalization alone is never the verification result.
Unquoted hypotheses, interpretations and candidate verdicts are not promoted to verified claims. The full input artifacts are retained for context.
Later seed verification does not restore deleted original blind-audit responses.
Unknown retrieval timestamps remain null; archive creation time is separate.
